sources.title: MiniMax-M3 — Open-Weight 1M-Context Multimodal Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3 is an open-weight frontier model released June 1, 2026: a ~428B/23B-active MoE with 1M context, native multimodality, and MiniMax Sparse Attention.
